implementation: Flutter member groups now resolve presence from the REST fallback plus authenticated realtime snapshots and per-member changes. When the realtime feed disconnects, fails, or supplies a malformed presence payload, all roster statuses resolve to unknown until the next complete valid snapshot.

checks.name: Guild presence resolver
checks.observation: Three unit tests cover REST fallback, authoritative snapshots, per-user change precedence, disconnect invalidation, recovery from a new snapshot, and malformed payload handling.

checks.name: Visible roster regrouping
checks.observation: Widget test verifies roster counts regroup to unknown after invalidation and restore online/offline sections after a fresh snapshot.

checks.name: Live two-account presence transitions
checks.reason: Requires a live deployment and two authenticated accounts; runtime/device acceptance remains open in the parity checklist.

remaining: Verify join/leave transitions and reconnect snapshot timing on the live backend with two accounts; anchored member-profile parity remains open.
